_comment: Supply spec for the routed decimator (issue #333): the klt erc half of T1
item 11 digital. Spec shape reused from the fleet's sky130 standard-cell
blocks (sky130-fpga flow/erc_supply_spec.json, sky130-trng
layout/trng_digital/erc-supply-spec.json) and extended per #333:
- Supplies are labelled twice on one conductor: VDDD/VSSD are the top-level
met5 strap labels (72/5), VPWR/VGND the per-cell met1 rail labels (68/5).
nets[].same_net_as declares each pair one node, so the PDN join is a
graded assertion (erc.expected_short_missing if it is ever cut), not a
suppressed erc.supply_short.
- roles: met4/met5 are the strap layers (sky130hd preset: met1 follow pins,
met4/met5 straps). Signal nets route a few segments there too (86 NEW
met4, 1 NEW met5 in decimator.def); every such cluster is reachable from
cell-pin labels, so the unlabelled-remainder measurement stays the
severed-orphan-strap negative it exists for. met1/met2/met3 carry signal
routing and are deliberately not owned.
- Ties: the 1625 sky130_fd_sc_hd__tapvpwrvgnd_1 cells tie the n-well
(64/20, nwell.drawing per the curated sky130 deck) to VPWR and the p-type
substrate to VGND through the dedicated tap layer (65/44, tap.drawing),
contacted up to li1. sky130 draws no p-well layer, so the substrate half
is the stream-derived complement of nwell (well_complement_of), never a
literal box list. No dnwell (64/18) is drawn on this stream.
- Antenna: not graded here (no --pdk); this spec is the supply evidence.
active_layer (diff 65/20) keeps gate areas physical for any future run.
